en: A monochrome postcard view of a large, early‑20th‑century military barracks complex standing behind a stone wall and open fields. Several multi‑storey buildings with mansard roofs and dormer windows form the complex, with a taller central section featuring a small tower or cupola. Forested land lies behind the buildings. At the top of the card, red printed text identifies the location and the type of building.
